headline: Kuura Strand Erupts; Weathered Expanse and Nevish Line Shift
war_summary: The front has shifted since the afternoon edition. Kuura Strand is the war's hottest quarter: ten actions in the past two hours, twelve in six and thirty-one across the day, with Menneen and Faden Point the chief points of contact and hourly casualties there near 471 Colonial and 550 Warden, the heaviest anywhere. Its lines remain mixed at five Colonial works to one Warden. In Weathered Expanse the Wardens have recovered a work, standing now at four Warden, three Colonial and two unclaimed after fifty-five actions in a day, chiefly about Frostmarch and Spirit Watch, at a day's cost of 8,034 Colonial and 8,733 Warden. The Nevish Line has changed again: Colonials now hold two works against six Warden, where the previous count gave the Wardens seven and one unclaimed, and the freshest action on the board is logged at Tomb Father. Marban Hollow reports four actions in two hours and thirty-three in the day, its ground split two Warden, three Colonial, three unclaimed. Pari Peak and Olavis Wake each logged twenty-two actions in the day but have quieted since evening; Farranac Coast, Callahan's Passage and Dead Lands remain costly without moving.
